card.name: Inside brand names ending in X
card.fires_on: The last piece before a final X in capitalized brand names such as BIMZELX, CABOMETYX, ZARXIO and DARZALEX. Also fires just before an x in Polistirex, COX-2 and x-ray.

modes.label: Brand names ending in X
modes.description: The syllable just before the closing X of an uppercase brand drug name in label text.
modes.example: periodically during treatment with BIMZ<<EL>>X and according to routine patient management.

modes.label: Other words with x
modes.description: A word just before an x in a generic name, COX-2 or x-ray.

card.writes: It promotes x-starting pieces such as XP, xen and XC, so it predicts that an X comes next.
card.plain: It fires inside a drug brand name when the next letter is likely to be an X.
